Step 3. By the compact spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01320023} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the compact spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via complex interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
